files.description: I took a broom and dustpan's handle and clicked the two together.  The second take was slightly metallic, whereas all the other takes focused more on the sound made by the plastic.  I used this for a spotlight's reveal effect during a game jam, though I added reverb to mine.  This is the raw take.
